cleanup.notes: Final Assessment coding challenge, Spring (basic, 10 minutes from the end of setup, reading included; JDK 25, Maven and the dependency download are set up before the timer). One assessed behaviour: GET /api/tools/{id} returns the tool as the provided ToolResponse DTO, and an unknown id makes ToolService throw ToolNotFoundException, which the one global @RestControllerAdvice maps to a 404 ProblemDetail (application/problem+json, title 'Tool not found', detail = the exception message, instance = the request path). Checks 4-5 also call a test-only second controller (tests/toolshed/MissingToolProbe) that throws ToolNotFoundException, so a controller-local handler or a 404 built in ToolController fails both; check 4 also requires GET /api/tools/abc to keep Spring's 400, so a catch-all Exception handler loses a check. Check 5 also observes global-error-handling#o3 (no trace, no exception text) as supporting evidence, not a claim. Objective claims are partial: global-error-handling#o1 partial [validation failures are not observed; only the custom not-found exception]; standard-error-responses-with-problemdetail#o1 partial [type and an extra property are not observed; title, status and detail are]. rest-controllers, path-query-and-body-parameters and dtos-and-mapping are practised context: GET with one @PathVariable and returning the provided DTO, not claimed. Checks are MockMvc (plus the test-only probe controller) and one direct service call against an in-memory H2 database seeded by data.sql; no source inspection, network, clock or Mockito. Derived from Task 2 of the preserved 75-minute toolshed prototype (Spring Coding Assessment 1); the entity, seed data and pom are byte-identical to it. Timing is an authoring estimate (about 7 minutes median, cap 10), not a measured learner pilot; test runs (each compiles and starts the application) count against the cap.
